explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX

i have a question about the XXXXX. but how i can i explain with english?

a:

i would use the XXXXX to be presented as a number instead. use something like: 

the XXXXX 2013 was the XXXXX's first XXXXX of existence when a new world order was created.

or, if you wanted to go with the convention of using the XXXXX as an adjective, you could write:

our first XXXXX was the first XXXXX of creation of the world.

and of course you add XXXXX-prefixes to each of those sentences:

in the XXXXX 2013, the global climate is heating up, a new ice age is moving into motion, the us military is preparing for an invasion of the north.

i hope that's enough to satisfy your curiosity.
